[SWS_DM_00372] Support of UDS service ReadDTCInformation, Subfunction 0x17
⌈
The Diagnostic Server instance shall support Sub-
function
0x17
(reportUserDefMemoryDTCByStatusMask)
of
the
UDS
service
0x19
ReadDTCInformation
according
to
ISO
14229-1[1],
provided
the
con-
figuration
contains
a
